h: H is a nonmetallic univalent element that is normally a colorless and odorless highly flammable diatomic gas.
H can also mean a unit of inductance in which an induced electromotive force of one volt is produced when the current is varied at the rate of one ampere per second.
H can also mean the constant of proportionality relating the energy of a photon to its frequency.
H means the same as hydrogen or atomic number 1 or henry.
h-bomb: H-bomb is a nuclear weapon that releases atomic energy by union of light nuclei at high temperatures to form helium.
H-bomb means the same as hydrogen bomb or fusion bomb or thermonuclear bomb.
h. g. wells: H. G. Wells is prolific English writer best known for his science-fiction novels.
H. G. Wells means the same as Wells or Herbert George Wells.
h. h. munro: H. H. Munro is British writer of short stories.
H. H. Munro means the same as Munro or Hector Hugh Munro or Saki.
h. j. eysenck: H. J. Eysenck is a British psychologist noted for his theories of intelligence and personality and for his strong criticism of Freudian psychoanalysis.
H. J. Eysenck means the same as Eysenck or Hans Eysenck or Hans Jurgen Eysenck.
h. l. mencken: H. L. Mencken is United States journalist and literary critic.
H. L. Mencken means the same as Mencken or Henry Louis Mencken.
h. pylori: H. pylori is the type species of genus Heliobacter.
H. pylori means the same as Heliobacter pylori.
H.I. is a group of volcanic and coral islands in the central Pacific.
H.I. means the same as Hawaiian Islands or Sandwich Islands.
h.m.s. bounty: H.M.S. Bounty is a ship of the British navy.
H.M.S. Bounty means the same as Bounty.
H.P. is a unit of power equal to 746 watts.
H.P. means the same as horsepower or HP.
h2o: H2O is binary compound that occurs at room temperature as a clear colorless odorless tasteless liquid.
H2O means the same as water.
h-shaped: H-shaped means shaped in the form of the letter H.
